## How it was tested

For an exercise: run on the lab, or not yet. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] No credentials, `clouds.yaml`, `config.env` values, passwords, private keys, real IP addresses or hostnames.
- [ ] A script that creates resources shows the estimated cost per hour (or "no cloud cost") and asks before creating anything.
- [ ] The delete command removes everything the scripts create, and was run to the end.
- [ ] Every step that changes state has a ⚠️ warning; every destructive step has a 🛑 warning.
- [ ] An exercise links to an existing runbook instead of copying it, and ends with the reminder to delete the lab.
- [ ] No marketing: no prices beyond the cost estimate, no promotional text, no logos.
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`).
